auth.description:
**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**

1. Log in to your [Wafeq account](https://app.wafeq.com/accounts/signup/).
2. In the left-side menu, open the **Developer** section and click **API Keys**.
3. Click **Create new key** and copy the key — you won't be able to see it again.
4. Click **Enable API**. The API is available on the **Starter plan** or higher (including free trials).
5. Paste the key below.

default_tax_rate.description: Tax applied to every line by default (e.g. "VAT 15%"). Leave blank if this invoice has no tax.

line_items.description: Add one row for each product or service on the document. Each row needs at least a description, quantity, and unit price. Leave the account and tax fields blank to use the defaults you set above.

description.description: What this line is for (e.g. "Consulting — April", "Office chair"). This is printed on the document.

quantity.description: How many units. Use 1 if unsure.

unit_amount.description: Price per single unit, in the currency you chose above (before tax).

item.description: Optional. Paste a Wafeq item ID here to link this line to a product in your catalog. You can get item IDs from the "List Items" action. Leave blank to just use the description and price.

account.description: Optional. Paste an account ID to override the default account you chose above — e.g. book this one line to a different sales account. Leave blank to use the default.

tax_rate.description: Optional. Paste a tax rate ID to override the default tax rate for this line only. Leave blank to use the default or no tax.

discount.description: Optional per-line discount, as a percentage (e.g. 10 for 10% off).

prices_include_tax.displayName: Do the prices above include tax?
prices_include_tax.description: If you already baked tax into the unit prices, pick "Yes". If tax should be added on top of the prices, pick "No". Most B2B invoices use "No".

options.label: No — add tax on top of the prices

status.description: Draft = still editable, not posted to your books yet. Sent = emailed to the customer. Finalized = locked and posted to your books. Start with Draft if unsure.

language.description: Language used on the PDF invoice sent to the customer.

reference.description: Optional text printed on the invoice (e.g. a project name or the customer's PO number).

notes.description: Optional notes printed at the bottom of the invoice (e.g. payment instructions, thank-you note).

external_id.description: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.

idempotency_key.description: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a sales (B2B) invoice in Wafeq for a customer contact, with line items, currency, tax handling, and a status (Draft/Sent/Finalized). Choose this for standard customer billing; use Create Simplified Invoice for retail/walk-in sales and Create Quote for estimates. Requires an existing contact ID and a unique invoice_number (reusing one is rejected). Not idempotent — each call posts a new invoice.

report_invoice_to_tax_authority.name: report_invoice_to_tax_authority

auth.description:

invoice.description: Pick which invoice to submit. ⚠️ The invoice must be in "Finalized" status first — if you just created it as a Draft, change its status to Finalized in Wafeq before running this action.

idempotency_key.description: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.

Choose this after an invoice has been created and moved to Finalized status; it will fail on draft invoices. Requires the invoice ID. Not idempotent — it is a reporting submission against the external authority.

create_contact.name: create_contact
create_contact.description: Add a new customer or supplier to your Wafeq address book so you can invoice them or record bills from them.

name.description: The business name (for companies) or full name (for individuals). This is what appears on invoices and bills.

relationship.description: Pick "Customer" if you sell to them, "Supplier" if you buy from them, or both if they're on both sides.

email.description: Where to send invoices and other documents. Optional but recommended — Wafeq can email invoices directly.

tax_registration_number.description: The contact's VAT registration number (also called TRN in UAE, TIN in some countries). Required for tax-compliant B2B invoices — leave blank for individuals.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code: AE = UAE, SA = Saudi Arabia, US = United States, GB = UK, etc.

address.description: Street / building address. This appears on printed invoices.

postal_code.description: The postal code. Must be exactly 5 digits for Saudi Arabia addresses.

external_id.description: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.

idempotency_key.description: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a contact (customer, supplier, or both) in Wafeq. Choose this when an invoice/bill needs a contact that does not exist yet; run Find Contact first to avoid duplicates, since this does not de-duplicate. Only name and relationship are required; tax_registration_number is needed for tax-compliant B2B documents. Not idempotent — each call creates a new contact.

find_contact.name: find_contact
find_contact.description: Search your Wafeq contacts by name, email, phone, or tax number. Useful for checking if a customer already exists before creating a new one.

keyword.description: Type what you're looking for — part of a name, email, phone number, or tax number works. Leave blank to list all contacts.

relationship.description: Only show customers, only suppliers, or both.

external_id.description: If you stored a reference ID when creating the contact (e.g. your CRM's customer ID), enter it here for an exact match.

limit.description: How many contacts to return at most. Default is 50, maximum is 200.

aiMetadata.description: Searches your Wafeq contacts by name, email, phone, or tax number. Choose this to look up a contact ID before creating an invoice/bill, or to check whether a customer already exists. Leaving the search keyword blank lists all contacts (a fetch-all mode); supply a keyword, relationship filter, or external_id to narrow results. Read-only and idempotent.

tax_rate.description: Optional. Paste a tax rate ID to override the default tax rate for this line only. Leave blank to use the default or no tax.

discount.description: Optional per-line discount, as a percentage (e.g. 10 for 10% off).

status.description: Draft = still editable. Sent = marked as sent to the customer. Start with Draft if unsure.

reference.description: Optional free text shown on the quote (e.g. project name).

notes.description: Optional notes printed at the bottom of the quote.

auth.description:
**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**

1. Log in to your [Wafeq account](https://app.wafeq.com/accounts/signup/).
2. In the left-side menu, open the **Developer** section and click **API Keys**.
3. Click **Create new key** and copy the key — you won't be able to see it again.
4. Click **Enable API**. The API is available on the **Starter plan** or higher (including free trials).
5. Paste the key below.

quote.description: Pick the quote you want to convert into an invoice.

idempotency_key.description: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.

aiMetadata.description: Converts an existing accepted quote into a new invoice in Wafeq, copying the customer, line items, and totals. Choose this after a quote created via Create Quote is approved, instead of re-entering the data as a fresh invoice. Requires the quote ID. Not idempotent — each call generates a new invoice from the quote.

download_invoice_pdf.name: download_invoice_pdf
download_invoice_pdf.description: Download an invoice as a PDF. You can attach the file to a Gmail / Outlook email, save it to Google Drive or Dropbox, or upload it anywhere else in the flow.

file_name.description: What to call the downloaded PDF. Leave blank to use "invoice-<id>.pdf". The ".pdf" extension is added automatically if you don't include it.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches an existing Wafeq invoice as a PDF file for downstream use (email attachment, cloud storage, upload). Choose this when a flow needs the rendered invoice document rather than its data fields. Requires the invoice ID; the file name is optional. Read-only and idempotent — re-running returns the same PDF.

create_item.name: create_item
create_item.description: Add a product or service to your Wafeq catalog. Catalog items can be quickly added to invoices, bills, and quotes without retyping descriptions or prices.

name.description: What the product or service is called (e.g. "Pro subscription", "Consulting hour"). This shows up in item pickers.

description.description: Optional longer description used as the default line text when this item is added to an invoice.

sku.description: Optional short code (e.g. "SUB-PRO-YR"). Useful if you also track the item in another system.

unit_price.description: How much you charge customers per unit. Used as the default on invoices and quotes.

unit_cost.description: How much you pay suppliers per unit. Used as the default on bills.

revenue_account.description: Advanced. The account ID sales of this item post to (e.g. "Sales Revenue"). Leave blank to use your org default.

expense_account.description: Advanced. The account ID purchases of this item post to.

revenue_tax_rate.description: Advanced. Tax rate ID applied when selling this item. Leave blank for no default tax.

purchase_tax_rate.description: Advanced. Tax rate ID applied when buying this item.

is_tracked_inventory.description: Turn on for physical products where you want Wafeq to track inventory counts. Leave off for services and digital products.

is_active.description: Active items can be added to new invoices. Turn off to hide the item from pickers without deleting it.

external_id.description: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.

idempotency_key.description: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a catalog item (product or service) in Wafeq with optional pricing, SKU, accounts, and inventory tracking, so it can be reused on invoices, bills, and quotes. Choose this to register a reusable item; only name is required. Not idempotent — each call adds a new catalog item.

list_items.name: list_items
list_items.description: List products and services from your Wafeq catalog. Useful for syncing your catalog to a spreadsheet or another system.

external_id.description: Find a single item by the reference ID you stored when creating it (e.g. your Shopify product ID).

created_after.description: Only return items created on or after this date.

created_before.description: Only return items created on or before this date.

limit.description: How many items to return at most. Default is 50, maximum is 200.

aiMetadata.description: Lists catalog items (products and services) from Wafeq, with optional filters for external_id and a created-date range. Choose this to export the catalog or look up item IDs; all filters are optional, so an unfiltered call returns the full catalog up to the result limit. Read-only and idempotent.

list_accounts.name: list_accounts
list_accounts.description: List accounts from your Wafeq chart of accounts. Useful for exporting your chart of accounts or finding account IDs you need elsewhere.

classification.description: Filter to one kind of account. Revenue = sales accounts, Expense = cost accounts, Asset = bank / inventory, Liability = loans / payables, Equity = owner's capital.

is_payment_enabled.description: Payment-enabled accounts are the bank, cash, or card accounts you can receive or send money from.

external_id.description: Return the single account matching this reference ID (if you've stored one).

limit.description: How many accounts to return at most. Default is 100, maximum is 500.

aiMetadata.description: Lists accounts from the Wafeq chart of accounts, optionally filtered by classification (Revenue/Expense/Asset/Liability/Equity), payment-enabled status, or external_id. Choose this to resolve the account IDs other actions require (e.g. a sales, expense, or bank account) or to export the chart of accounts. Read-only and idempotent.

nl.\n**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**\n\n:
**Hoe je je Wafeq API Key te verkrijgen:**

1. Log in op je [Wafeq account](https://app.wafeq.com/accounts/signup/).
2. Open in het menu aan de linkerkant de **Ontwikkelaar** sectie en klik op **API Keys**.
3. Klik op **Nieuwe sleutel maken** en kopieer de sleutel - u kunt deze niet meer zien.

5. Plak de sleutel hieronder.
nl.Create a new sales invoice for a custome: Maak een nieuwe verkoopfactuur voor een klant aan.
nl.Submit an invoice to the tax authority (: Stuur een factuur naar de belastingautoriteit (ZATCA in Saoedi-Arabië, de vrijhandelsovereenkomst in de UAE). De factuur moet al zijn afgerond in Wafeq voordat u hem kunt melden.
nl.Add a new customer or supplier to your W: Voeg een nieuwe klant of leverancier toe aan uw Wafeq adresboek, zodat u hem kunt factureren of facturen van hen kunt ontvangen.
nl.Search your Wafeq contacts by name, emai: Zoek uw Wafeq contacten op naam, e-mail, telefoon of BTW-nummer. Nuttig om te controleren of een klant al bestaat voordat u een nieuwe aanmaakt.

nl.Issue a credit note to a customer — used: Geef een creditnota aan een klant — wordt gebruikt wanneer u hem terugbetaalt, corrigeer een overladen of neem goederen terug. Een creditnota vermindert hoeveel de klant u verschuldigd is.
nl.Send a customer a quote (also called an: Stuur een klant een offerte (ook wel ingeschreven). Offertes kunnen later worden omgezet in een factuur met de actie "Offerte converteren naar factuur".

de.\n**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**\n\n:
**Wie Sie Ihren Wafeq-API-Schlüssel bekommen:**

2. Im linken Menü öffnen Sie den Abschnitt **Entwickler** und klicken Sie auf **API Keys**.
3. Klicke **Erstelle neuen Schlüssel** und kopiere den Schlüssel — du wirst ihn nicht mehr sehen.
4. Klicke **API aktivieren**. Die API ist auf dem **Starterplan** oder höher (einschließlich kostenloser Testversionen) verfügbar.

de.Record money received from a customer (p: Rekord Geld von einem Kunden erhalten (Zahlung einer Rechnung) oder Geld an einen Anbieter (Zahlung einer Rechnung).

de.Send a customer a quote (also called an: Senden Sie einem Kunden einen Kostenvoranschlag (auch Schätzung genannt). Zitate können später mit der Aktion "Angebot in Rechnung umwandeln" in eine Rechnung umgewandelt werden.

de.Download an invoice as a PDF. You can at: Laden Sie eine Rechnung als PDF herunter. Sie können die Datei an eine Gmail / Outlook E-Mail anhängen, speichern Sie es in Google Drive oder Dropbox oder laden Sie es irgendwo sonst im Fluss hoch.

de.List products and services from your Waf: Listen Sie Produkte und Dienstleistungen aus Ihrem Wafeq-Katalog auf. Nützlich, um Ihren Katalog mit einer Tabellenkalkulation oder einem anderen System zu synchronisieren.
de.List accounts from your Wafeq chart of a: Listen Sie Konten aus Ihrem Wafeq-Kontenplan auf. Nützlich für den Export Ihres Kontendiagramms oder das Finden von Konto-IDs, die Sie anderswo benötigen.
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen

de.Who are you billing? Pick from your Wafe: Wer sind Sie Rechnung? Wählen Sie aus Ihren Wafeq-Kontakten.

de.Add one row for each product or service: Fügen Sie eine Zeile für jedes Produkt oder jeden Service in das Dokument ein. de.If you already baked tax into the unit p: Wenn Sie bereits Steuern in die Einheitspreise gebacken haben, wählen Sie "Ja". Wenn Steuern zusätzlich zu den Preisen erhoben werden sollen, wählen Sie "Nein".
de.Draft = still editable, not posted to yo: Entwurf = noch editierbar, noch nicht in Ihren Büchern veröffentlicht. Senden = an den Kunden gesendet. Finalized = gesperrt und gepostet in Ihren Büchern. Beginnen Sie mit dem Entwurf, wenn Sie sich nicht sicher sind.

de.Pick which invoice to submit. ⚠️ The inv: Wähle die Rechnung aus, die gesendet werden soll. :Warnung: Die Rechnung muss zuerst im Status "fertiggestellt" sein — wenn Sie sie gerade als Entwurf erstellt haben, den Status in Wafeq ändern, bevor diese Aktion ausgeführt wird.

de.Pick \"Customer\" if you sell to them, \: Wählen Sie "Kunde", wenn Sie ihnen verkaufen, "Lieferanten", wenn Sie von ihnen kaufen, oder beidseitig, wenn sie beide Seiten sind.
de.Where to send invoices and other documen: Wo Rechnungen und andere Dokumente gesendet werden. Optional, aber empfohlen — Wafeq kann Rechnungen direkt per E-Mail senden.
de.The contact's VAT registration number (a: Die Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer des Kontakts (auch TRN in UAE, TIN in einigen Ländern). Benötigt für steuerkonforme B2B-Rechnungen — leer lassen für Einzelpersonen.

de.The invoice number printed on the suppli: Die Rechnungsnummer, die auf der Rechnung des Lieferanten ausgedruckt ist (damit Sie es später passieren können). Muss pro Lieferant in Ihrem Wafeq Org einmalig sein.

es.\n**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**\n\n:
**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**

1. Log in to your [Wafeq account](https://app.wafeq.com/accounts/signup/).
2. In the left-side menu, open the **Developer** section and click **API Keys**.
3. Click **Create new key** and copy the key — you won't be able to see it again.
4. Click **Enable API**. The API is available on the **Starter plan** or higher (including free trials).
5. Paste the key below.

**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**

1. Log in to your [Wafeq account](https://app.wafeq.com/accounts/signup/).

pt.Cloud accounting software for invoicing,: Nuvem de software para faturamento, faturas, despesas e relatórios de impostos (ZATCA, UAE FTA).
pt.\n**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**\n\n:
**Como receber sua chave de API do Wafeq:**

1. Inicie a sessão na sua [conta do Wafeq](https://app.wafeq.com/accounts/signup/).
2. No menu do lado esquerdo, abra a seção **Desenvolvedor** e clique em **chaves da API**.
3. Clique em **Criar nova chave** e copie a chave — você não será capaz de vê-la novamente.
4. Clique em **Habilitar API**. A API está disponível no **Plano Inicial** ou superior (incluindo testes gratuitos).
5. Cole a chave abaixo.
pt.Create a new sales invoice for a custome: Criar uma nova fatura de venda para um cliente.
pt.Submit an invoice to the tax authority (: Envie uma fatura para a autoridade fiscal (ZATCA na Arábia Saudita, FTA na UAE). A fatura já deve ser finalizada em Wafeq antes de você poder reportá-la.
pt.Add a new customer or supplier to your W: Adicione um novo cliente ou fornecedor ao seu livro de endereços do Wafeq para que você possa faturá-lo ou gravar faturas dele.
pt.Search your Wafeq contacts by name, emai: Procure os seus contatos Wafeq por nome, e-mail, telefone ou número de impostos. Útil para verificar se um cliente já existe antes de criar um novo.
pt.Record a bill you received from a suppli: Registre uma fatura que você recebeu de um fornecedor (por exemplo, uma fatura do fornecedor que você precisa pagar).
pt.Record money received from a customer (p: Registrar o dinheiro recebido de um cliente (pagar uma fatura) ou o dinheiro enviado a um fornecedor (pagar uma conta).
pt.Create a simplified (retail) tax invoice: Crie uma fatura de imposto simplificada (varejo) — usada para vendas em caminhada/balcão, especialmente na Arábia Saudita sob a ZATCA. Em vez disso, utilize uma fatura regular para as vendas B2B.
pt.Issue a credit note to a customer — used: Dê uma nota de crédito a um cliente — usada ao devolvê-la, corrigir uma cobrança excessiva ou receber de volta produtos. Uma nota de crédito reduz o quanto o cliente deve a você.
pt.Send a customer a quote (also called an: Envie um orçamento para o cliente (também chamado de estimativa). Os orçamentos podem ser convertidos mais tarde em uma fatura com a ação "Converter orçamento em fatura".
pt.Turn a customer-accepted quote into a re: Transforme uma cotação aceita pelo cliente em uma fatura real. A nova fatura copia o cliente, itens de linha e totaliza a partir da cotação.
pt.Download an invoice as a PDF. You can at: Baixe uma fatura como PDF. Você pode anexar o arquivo a um e-mail do Gmail / Outlook salve-o no Google Drive ou Dropbox, ou carregue-o em qualquer outro lugar do fluxo.
pt.Add a product or service to your Wafeq c: Adicione um produto ou serviço ao seu catálogo de Wafeq. Os itens do catálogo podem ser rapidamente adicionados a faturas, faturas e cotações sem redigitar descrições ou preços.
pt.List products and services from your Waf: Liste produtos e serviços do seu catálogo de Wafeq. Útil para sincronizar seu catálogo com uma planilha ou outro sistema.
pt.List accounts from your Wafeq chart of a: Liste contas do seu gráfico Wafeq de contas. Útil para exportar seu gráfico de contas ou encontrar IDs de conta que você precisa em outro lugar.
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico

pt.If you already baked tax into the unit p: Se você já cobrou impostos nos preços unitários, escolha "Sim". Se impostos devem ser adicionados acima dos preços, escolha "Não". Maioria das faturas B2B usam "Não".
pt.Draft = still editable, not posted to yo: Rascunho = ainda editável, não publicado nos seus livros ainda. Enviado = enviado para o cliente Finalizado = bloqueado e postado nos seus livros. Comece com o rascunho, se não tiver certeza.

pt.Optional notes printed at the bottom of: Notas opcionais impressas na parte inferior da fatura (por exemplo, instruções de pagamento, nota de agradecimento).
pt.Optional. Store an ID from another syste: Opcional. Armazene aqui um ID de outro sistema (por exemplo, o número de pedido da sua loja online) para que você possa encontrar esse registro em Wafeq mais tarde.

pt.Pick which invoice to submit. ⚠️ The inv: Escolha qual fatura enviar. ⚠️ A fatura deve estar no estado "Finalizado" primeiro — se você acabou de criá-la como um rascunho, altere seu status para Finalizado em Wafeq antes de executar esta ação.

pt.HEAD: CABEÇA
pt.Fires every time a new invoice is create: Atira toda vez que uma nova fatura é criada no Wafeq. Útil para registrar vendas em uma planilha, postar no Slack, ou sincronizar com outro sistema.
pt.Fires when a new bill from a supplier is: Atira quando uma nova fatura de um fornecedor é criada. Útil para aprovação de fluxos de trabalho — e. . poste a nova conta em um canal do Slack para que um gerente possa autorizar.
pt.Fires every time a new customer or suppl: Efetua sempre que um novo cliente ou fornecedor é adicionado ao seu livro de endereços do Wafeq. Útil para sincronizar novos clientes ao HubSpot, Mailchimp, ou seu CRM.
pt.Fires every time a payment is recorded i: Efetua toda vez que um pagamento é registrado no Wafeq. Ótimo para celebrar a receita no Slack, acionar os cálculos da comissão ou enviar um recibo ao cliente.
pt.Only fire on new customers, only supplie: Devolver apenas sobre os novos clientes, somente fornecedores ou ambos.
